NEWS RELEASE - FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Contact: Brian Patton, Deputy Director, Idaho Department of Water Resources, 208-287-4800 IDWR Director grants motion to stay enforcement of curtailment in Big and Little Lost River Basins through May 4 BOISE - (April 17, 2026) – The Director of the Idaho Department of Water Resources (IDWR) granted a motion filed today by the Surface Water Coalition (SWC) and the Eastern Snake Plain Aquifer (ESPA)-area Ground Water Districts, requesting that the Director place a “stay” on curtailing junior groundwater users in the Big and Little Lost River Basins until May 4th. The stay will allow groundwater users in the Big Lost Ground Water District, the Little Lost Ground Water District, and the Upper Big Lost Ground Water District to irrigate their crops immediately while the SWC, and the ground water districts work out the technical issues related to adding those Lost River groundwater users into the 2024 mitigation plan. Under Idaho water law, surface water users with senior water rights have priority over water users with junior rights on the Snake River and the ESPA. The rule of law is “first in time, first in right.” On the Snake River, IDWR manages both surface and groundwater resources together as one whole, or “conjunctively,” in calculating impacts each year. On Thursday, April 15, the IDWR Director issued an April Methodology Order indicating that certain groundwater users who draw water from the ESPA with a priority date junior to Oct. 11, 1900, must be covered by an IDWR-approved mitigation plan by May 1, 2026, or they could face curtailment. The order includes groundwater users in portions of the Big and Little Lost River Basins that were included in the ESPA Area of Common Groundwater Supply (ACGWS) through passage of Senate Bill 1341 in 2024 and phased into administration on November 1, 2025. With the approval of the motion filed by SWC and the groundwater districts today, IDWR will pause the enforcement of the existing Snake River curtailment order within the Big Lost Ground Water District, Little Lost Ground Water District, and Upper Big Lost Ground Water District until May 4th, when an updated settlement may be reached by the senior and junior water users in the ESPA region. ######################################
